title: Ghadar: Punjabi issue of 23 December 1913
alt: Gurmukhi newspaper front page with a large Ghadar masthead and two handwritten columns
caption: A handwritten Punjabi front page dated 23 December 1913 in the catalogue. This is a later issue, not the first Urdu issue of 1 November. The languages, scripts and publication dates must remain distinct. Reproduced without further cropping.

title: Chauri Chaura: later memorial
alt: Entrance arch and gate framing the tall Chauri Chaura memorial
caption: A modern memorial photograph, catalogued 15 March 2000. It records remembrance rather than the police-station attack or the subsequent trials in 1922. Reproduced without further cropping.

title: Vedaranyam salt march, April 1930
alt: A crowd walking with staffs and flags during the Vedaranyam salt campaign
caption: The source identifies Rajagopalachari leading this regional salt march in April 1930. It is not Gandhi at Dandi. A route map still needs separately verified stopping places and dates. Reproduced without further cropping.

title: Vedaranyam: salt satyagraha memorial
alt: Yellow memorial column with an emblem and tricolour bands beside an open field
caption: Photographed on 24 March 2007. Compare the later memorial with the campaign photograph; the monument is not a structure documented here as standing during the 1930 march. Reproduced without further cropping.

title: Gandhi during the Kheda campaign, 1918
alt: Gandhi seated in a turban and white clothing before patterned textiles
caption: A portrait associated with the 1918 campaign, reproduced from Judith Brown, Gandhi: Prisoner of Hope (1989), page 116. It identifies a participant; it does not show peasants withholding revenue or establish the terms of a settlement. Reproduced without further cropping.

title: Leaders associated with Vaikom Satyagraha, 1924
alt: Campaign participants arranged in seated and standing rows in a faded group portrait
caption: The catalogue identifies this group with the 1924 campaign. The portrait is not a photograph of a temple opening or proof that all caste restrictions ended. Individual identifications should be checked against an archival key. Reproduced without further cropping.

title: Gandhi in Cochin during the Vaikom campaign, 1925
alt: Gandhi and companions seen in a crowded doorway
caption: The catalogue dates this view to 1925. It gives later context within the 1924-25 campaign, not a photograph of its opening day. Road access and entry into the temple were different demands and outcomes. Reproduced without further cropping.

title: Mahad water-rights movement: later sculpture
alt: Bronze relief depicting Ambedkar holding water with a crowd behind him
caption: A bronze commemorative representation photographed in December 2013. It interprets the 1927 water-rights struggle; it is not an eyewitness image of Ambedkar drinking from the tank. The source description contains broader claims that are not adopted here. Reproduced without further cropping.

title: Ambedkar, Jayakar and Sapru at Yerwada, September 1932
alt: Ambedkar, Jayakar, Sapru and a companion standing beside a car
caption: The catalogue identifies Ambedkar with M. R. Jayakar and Tej Bahadur Sapru at Yerwada on 24 September 1932. A posed photograph does not prove an uncomplicated agreement: political safeguards and the pressures surrounding the pact require the document and competing accounts. Reproduced without further cropping.

title: Rani Gaidinliu: commemorative stamp, 1996
alt: Indian postage stamp with a blue-green portrait of Rani Gaidinliu and the year 1996
caption: India Post issued this stamp on 12 September 1996. It is a post-independence commemoration, not a photograph of her arrest or imprisonment beginning in 1932. A dated prison record remains requested. Reproduced without further cropping.
credit: India Post, Government of India / Wikimedia Commons

title: Usha Mehta: later portrait
alt: Older Usha Mehta speaking into a microphone
caption: The Publications Division reproduction identifies the portrait as 1996 and its publication as August 1997. This is a later portrait of the Congress Radio organiser, not an image of a 1942 broadcast or a surviving transmitter. Reproduced without further cropping.
credit: Publication division, Government of India / Wikimedia Commons

title: Gandhi and Patel associated with Bardoli, 1928
alt: Gandhi and Patel seated with companions on a decorated platform
caption: The catalogue associates this photograph with the 1928 Bardoli Satyagraha. It offers leadership context, not a record of every village, revenue assessment or negotiation. Reproduced without further cropping.

title: Surya Sen: circulated portrait
alt: Printed head-and-shoulders portrait of Surya Sen
caption: A reproduced portrait catalogued as published in a British police gazette in the 1930s. The underlying exposure date and photographer are unconfirmed. It is not a photograph of the armoury raid on 18 April 1930; the police circulation context matters. Reproduced without further cropping.
credit: Unidentified original photographer; scan by Tanveer Islam / Wikimedia Commons

title: Bhagat Singh: portrait, 1929
alt: Bhagat Singh in a felt hat, collared shirt and moustache
caption: A 1929 portrait reproduced by the Shahid Bhagat Singh Research Committee, Ludhiana. It predates the execution in March 1931 and is not an image taken in the condemned cell. The precise day attributed by later accounts is not asserted here. Reproduced without further cropping.

title: Karachi Congress, 1931
alt: A large seated outdoor gathering around a flagpole and raised platform
caption: A Congress gathering identified in the catalogue as Karachi, 1931. It provides context for the session, not proof of a particular clause being adopted. Read the rights and economic programme in the linked resolution. Reproduced without further cropping.

title: Rajendra Prasad and Anugrah Narayan Sinha: Champaran context
alt: Four organisers in white clothes and caps, two seated and two standing
caption: The catalogue identifies these organisers with the 1917 Champaran campaign, citing Anugrah Abhinandan Granth (1946) through an educational institution. It is a later reproduction of an attributed campaign photograph, not the inquiry proceedings or a tenant petition. Reproduced without further cropping.
credit: Unidentified photographer; reproduced in Anugrah Abhinandan Granth (1946) / Wikimedia Commons

title: Annie Besant: portrait, c. 1897
alt: Annie Besant seated in a patterned dress, looking slightly to the right
caption: Hollinger & Rockey, c. 1897; Library of Congress LC-USZ62-103990. This portrait predates the Home Rule leagues by almost two decades. It identifies a campaign leader, not a 1916 meeting or a Home Rule leaflet. Reproduced without further cropping.
credit: Hollinger & Rockey / Library of Congress / Wikimedia Commons
